verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. Sign in with ChatGPT is an identity-sharing feature, not credential issuance. Plugins prompting you to connect an external service, and marketplace 'authentication policies', are adjacent auth features. A community user's read-only database connection is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
